title_original: 베트남산 합판에 대한 덤핑방지관세 부과에 관한 규칙
full_text:
ADDENDA <No. 1076, July 2, 2024>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Article 2 (Period of Validity) These Rules shall remain in force for five years from the date of their promulgation.

Article 3 (Applicability to Goods Subject to Anti-Dumping Measures during the Review Period) These Rules shall apply to goods for which import declarations were filed on or after November 6, 2023.
